data.body: 0a8c claimed (needed a fresh review-plan first: PASS, 0 blocking, 14 advisory - notable ones: no rollback path for a destructive migration, and no TOCTOU guard between dry-run and live run; both reinforce pausing before the live store mutation). Oracle authored to the repo's OWN held-out convention (tests/scripts/test_X.py + test_X_heldout.py, which the backfill scripts already use): 2 happy-path cases (SC-only rename, SC-merges-into-existing-AC) + 14 held-out (mixed bullet styles, SC-as-last-section, no-op, _count_ac_items>=1 across 4 shapes, premise guard that unmigrated SC scores 0, prose-outside-block preserved byte-for-byte, ### does not terminate the block, non-bullet prose not checkboxed, idempotency x3). Removed one structural change-detector I wrote (asserting on __code__.co_varnames/__defaults__) - the dry-run-default contract will be verified observably against the real store instead. RED: first run failed 15x on FileNotFoundError which is NOT honest RED (assertions never exercised), so added a NotImplementedError stub; now 15 RED on real absence of behavior, 1 passing = the premise guard proving SC bullets score 0 to the floor today.
